_comment: Text is lowercased and accents are stripped before matching; mask phrases and patterns get the same treatment, so accents are optional.
Mask phrases (operator warnings like 'never share') are blanked out before rules run, per phrase, not per message (PRD 7.1).
Rules run on every message regardless of the selected language; 'lang' lists the languages a rule's patterns cover. The selected language only picks the reason text.
Optional 'sender_types' limits a rule to those sender types. Optional 'allow' lists official domains a link may point to (empty until verified, PRD 16).
Pidgin (pcm) phrases and reasons need review by a native speaker (PRD 16).
